_note: Tranche 4, 'what people actually convert': acquisition reopened by owner request (2026-10-04) to sample the documents ordinary users hand a converter -- Word/PowerPoint/Excel direct exports, Google Docs, Apple Pages, LibreOffice, journal and arXiv papers, resumes, RTL and complex scripts, OCR'd scans, designed government publications, legal and statistical layouts. Every URL here was verified by full download (%PDF magic, Producer/Creator read from the file) and every licence was checked against the cited page or the statement printed in the document before it entered the plan; rejects and the rule that produced them are recorded in docs/corpus-expansion.md s13. Tiers are provisional until measured (s4). The tranche-2 and tranche-3 plans stay closed and untouched.

candidates.why: DOE Inspector General audit report DOE-OIG-25-20, 21 pages. Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365 direct export (no Acrobat): memorandum page, a two-column Highlights page, TOC, footnotes, tables, raster charts, running footer 'DOE-OIG-25-20 | n | P a g e'. Licence: US federal work; DOE web policy: 'Government information at DOE websites is in the public domain.' No statement inside the PDF.

MHCLG ministerial letter, 4 pages, A4. Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365 direct export: crest letterhead, address block, run-in bold headings, signature image -- the letter class the corpus lacked. Licence: the GOV.UK publication page states 'All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated'; OGL v3 covers crests that form an integral part of a document. Site-level basis, none inside the PDF.

NZ Ministry of Health guideline, 33 pages. Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365 direct export: multi-level numbered headings (2.3.1), TOC plus List of Tables, 10 tables, shaded note boxes, two-line running footer. Licence printed on p3: 'This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence.'

HM Treasury policy note, 18 pages. Producer 'Microsoft: Print To PDF' (Word printed through the Windows print-to-PDF driver; fonts arrive as generic CIDFont+Fn names) -- a chain new to the corpus. Contents page, numbered paragraphs, footnotes, annex. Licence printed on p3: 'This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.'

UK Government response to the Notifiable Acquisition Regulations consultation, 37 pages. Producer 'Skia/PDF m147 Google Docs Renderer' -- a real Google Docs export of an ordinary English report, the first in the corpus. Licence printed on p4: 'This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.'

NZ MBIE discussion paper on open banking regulations, 60 pages. Producer and Creator 'Power PDF Create' (Kofax/Nuance Power PDF) -- a commercial PDF writer new to the corpus. Licence printed on p2: 'This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.'

US Census Bureau 2024 ACS 1-year pre-release presentation, 40 slides at 960x540. Microsoft PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 direct export -- the slide-deck class the corpus lacked: bullet slides, native tables, website screenshots, footer logo. Licence: US federal work, publisher identity; no statement inside the PDF.

DWP benefit and pension rates 2026-27, 14 pages A4. Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 direct export: a spreadsheet print area with an 'Official' header and footer, a two-column numeric rate grid, no gridlines -- the tabular Excel class the corpus lacked. Licence: GOV.UK publication page, 'All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated'; none inside the PDF.

LibreOffice Writer Guide 7.1, chapter 1, 25 pages. Producer 'LibreOffice 7.1' / Creator 'Writer' -- a real-world LibreOffice export (every other LibreOffice fixture was generated here). UI screenshots, Tip/Note boxes, tables, header and footer. Licence printed on p2: GPL v3 or later, or 'the Creative Commons Attribution License ... version 4.0 or later'.

PLOS ONE article (doi 10.1371/journal.pone.0322937), 22 pages. Producer 'MiKTeX-dvipdfmx (20220710)' -- PLOS's LaTeX pipeline through dvipdfmx: left metadata sidebar on p1, 10 tables, ~30 numbered equations, references. 22 invisible 3x3pt ARFix button widgets (not a form). Licence printed on p1: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License'; the article page links CC BY 4.0.

eLife 'Ten simple rules for the computational modeling of behavioral data' (49547 v2), 33 pages. Producer 'GPL Ghostscript 9.15' from 'Arbortext Advanced Print Publisher 9.0' -- a journal chain new to the corpus. Equations, text boxes, figures, footnote marks. Advent math fonts extract '=' as a fraction glyph. Licence printed on p1 ('distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License'); the eLife API record states CC-BY-4.0.

Copernicus/EGU Nonlinear Processes in Geophysics article, 11 pages, two-column throughout on a 595x785 page. pdfTeX 1.40.19 via copernicus.cls 'produced from XML': 21 numbered equations, table, figures. Licence printed on p1: 'This work is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.'

Frontiers in Applied Mathematics and Statistics article, 10 pages, A4 two-column. Producer 'dvips + MiKTeX GPL Ghostscript 9.0' / 'LaTeX with hyperref package + hypdvips' -- the DVI-to-PostScript-to-Ghostscript chain, new to the corpus. 37 numbered equations. Licence printed on p1: 'distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY)'; the article page links CC BY 4.0.

arXiv 2309.06427v2 (ICRA 2024), 8 pages, IEEEtran conference two-column: ~48 numbered equations with matrices, affiliation footnotes, rotated arXiv margin stamp. pdfTeX 1.40.25. Per-paper licence on the abs page: creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 (not the default arXiv licence).

arXiv 2405.07767v1 (SIGIR 2024), 5 pages, ACM acmart sigconf two-column: tables, vector plots, footnotes, ACM rights block. pdfTeX 1.40.25 (TeX Live 2023). Licence printed on p1: 'This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution International 4.0 License.'; abs page links CC BY 4.0.

arXiv 2310.20030v1 (NeurIPS 2023), 15 pages, NeurIPS one-column style: 34 numbered equations, tables, figures, footnote. pdfTeX 1.40.25. Per-paper licence on the abs page: creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0.

RenderCV example CV (moderncv theme) for the placeholder person 'John Doe', 3 pages. Creator 'Typst 0.14.2' (the corpus holds 0.13.1): date-column grid, icons, bullet lists. MIT licence of the repository that ships the file at this commit.

Single-column academic CV template sample (the fictional Prof. Moritz-Maria von Igelfeld), 3 pages, pdfTeX 1.40.28: small-caps headings, numbered publication list, three-part footer. MIT licence of the repository that ships the file at this commit.

Two-column one-page resume template showcase (fictional person), A4, producer 'xdvipdfmx (0.1)': right-aligned left column, avatar drawing, icon glyphs, skill-dot ratings. MIT licence of the repository at this commit.

ILO International Labour Conference report ILC.114/VI, Arabic edition, 57 pages A4. 'Microsoft Word pour Microsoft 365' (French-UI Word) direct export: right-to-left body with embedded LTR runs, ~26 tables, and 333 navigation push-button widgets (a per-page sidebar, not data entry). Licence printed on p3 (translated): 'This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence.'

Arabic technical note on ISO 55001, 7 pages A4. Producer 'WeasyPrint 70.0' -- an HTML/CSS-to-PDF engine new to the corpus: RTL bullet lists, stat-card boxes, a callout with a coloured border, mixed LTR runs. Licence printed on p7 ('CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International)'); Zenodo record cc-by-4.0.

Hebrew methodological article on courtroom observation (authors' manuscript), 28 pages A4. Microsoft Word 2016 direct export: Hebrew RTL body (David/Narkisim), ~10 tables. Licence: the authors' Zenodo record, cc-by-4.0 (verified via the Zenodo API); none inside the PDF.

Persian conference paper on deep-learning sentiment analysis, 15 pages A4. Microsoft Word 2016 direct export; confirmed Persian (farsi yeh, keheh, gaf, pe, che, zhe), B Nazanin font, tables, figures. Licence: the authors' Zenodo record, cc-by-4.0; none inside the PDF. Caveat recorded: the proceedings also appeared with an ISBN, and this licence rests on the authors' own deposit.

Japanese Digital Agency explanatory note on the Public Data License, 12 pages A4. Producer 'JUST PDF 4' (JustSystems) -- a Japanese PDF writer new to the corpus; MS Mincho/Gothic with Shift-JIS font names, framed quotation boxes drawn as vector paths. Licence: the agency copyright policy applies PDL1.0 'unless a rights notice is shown'; PDL1.0 s1.7.3 declares compatibility with CC BY 4.0.

Taiwan Ministry of Digital Affairs business document, Traditional Chinese, 51 pages A4. Word for Microsoft 365 with the zh-TW interface string as Producer: DFKaiShu body, (yi)/(1) numbering, hanging indents; pages 2 and 4 blank. Licence: the ministry's open-data declaration releases all site materials under CC0 1.0; none inside the PDF.
candidates.expected_producer: 適用於 Microsoft 365 的 Microsoft® Word

candidates.why: Korean preprint on adjudication theory, 28 pages Letter. Microsoft Word 2016 direct export: Hangul body (Malgun Gothic), Palatino, Cambria Math. Licence: the author's Zenodo record, cc-by-4.0; none inside the PDF. Chosen over a Hancom/Hwp press release whose KOGL grant covers 'text only'.

Hindi essay on Indian AI, 4 pages. Producer 'Skia/PDF m136 Google Docs Renderer' (a .docx opened and exported by Google Docs): Devanagari in Mangal, headings, rules, bullet lists, zero-width spaces. Licence: the author's Zenodo record, cc-by-4.0; none inside the PDF.

Thai translation of an essay, 3 pages Letter, PDF 1.3. Producer 'macOS Version 15.7.1 Quartz PDFContext' / Creator 'Pages' -- Apple Pages, new to the corpus: Thonburi for Thai, Roman-numeral headings. Licence: the author's Zenodo record, cc-by-4.0; none inside the PDF.

USDA Department Circular 155 (1921), 10 small pamphlet pages scanned by the Internet Archive: page images with an invisible OCR text layer, producer 'Recoded by LuraDocument PDF v2.53' (MRC-layered). Public domain twice over: a US federal work and published before 1929; archive.org rights: 'The contributing institution believes that this item is not in copyright.'

USDA Office of Information list no. 8 (1950), 16 pages scanned by the Internet Archive: current-generation 'Internet Archive PDF 1.2.2; including mupdf and pymupdf/skimage' with a GlyphLessFont OCR layer, uneven OCR quality. US federal work; archive.org rights: 'The contributing institution believes that this item is not in copyright.'

SSA sample 'Your Social Security Statement' (2025 redesign) for the fictional 'Wanda Worker', 2 pages. Adobe InDesign 20.2 via Adobe PDF Library 17.0 -- the statement class, designed two-column with a benefits chart. US federal work, publisher identity; SSA's own policy page refuses automated fetches, so usa.gov is cited. None inside the PDF.

CMS annotated sample Medicare Summary Notice (Part B), 6 landscape pages. Adobe InDesign CS4 (6.0.6) via PDF Library 9.0 -- the oldest InDesign generation in the corpus: callout annotations around a statement, multi-region layout, and a Mandarin help line (CJK). CMS 'Link to Us': 'It is a public domain web site.'

CDC MMWR weekly issue Vol. 73 No. 17 (2 May 2024), 24 pages. Adobe InDesign 19.4 via PDF Library 17.0: two-column newsletter typesetting with dense footnoted tables, vector charts, running header and footer, no raster images. Printed on p24: 'All material in the MMWR Series is in the public domain and may be used and reprinted without permission'.

Federal Register 89 FR 68114-68117 (EPA ethaboxam tolerances), 4 pages. GPO three-column typesetting, producer iText Core 7.2.3 / govinfo: running heads, a dot-leader table, the next document starting on p4. One GPO digital-signature widget (not a form). US federal work; govinfo policy cites 17 U.S.C. 105.

H.R. 4639 (118th Congress), reported in House, 20 pages. Acrobat Distiller 23.0 modified by GPO's iText: calendar cover, then line-numbered bill text (1-25 per page), small caps, hanging subsection indents. One GPO digital-signature widget (not a form). US federal work.

S.D. Cal. order 3:23-cv-00770 (17 Jan 2025), 5 pages. Word for Microsoft 365 then stamped by the AO's and GPO's iText: California pleading paper with left-margin line numbers 1-28 and double rules, caption table, footnotes, CM/ECF header stamp. Federal court work; the plaintiff is anonymised by the court. GPO signature widget only.

BLS 'The Employment Situation -- April 2025', 39 pages. Creator 'XPP' (the XyEnterprise/SDL XPP typesetting system), finished in Acrobat Pro 25 -- new to the corpus: prose release then ~30 pages of dense statistical tables with dot leaders and spanning heads; no raster images. BLS: published material is in the public domain except previously copyrighted photographs (this release has none).

NRC public meeting notice (annual assessment), 3 pages. Creator 'JasperReports (MeetingDetails)', producer iText 2.1.7 -- a database report generator, the class corpus-expansion.md s3 names and had never sampled. US federal work, publisher identity; none inside the PDF.
